'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]], [[India–Pakistan relations]]
**[[2026 Balochistan attacks]]
***[[Pakistan]]i [[Pakistan Armed Forces|military]] and [[Balochistan Police]] forces announce the end to a 40-hour [[counterterrorism]] operation which resulted in the deaths of 145 [[Baloch Liberation Army]] (BLA) insurgents, 18 civilians, and 18 security personnel. The [[Government of Pakistan|Pakistani government]] accuses [[India]] of backing the BLA. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-insurgency-balochistan-deadly-attacks-militants-killed-51af1ee3b96f6fac5d2abfa21a607ad8 (AP)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Dnipro strikes (2022–present)|Dnipro strikes]]
***A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[drone warfare|drone strike]] hits a [[minibus]] transporting mineworkers in [[Dnipro]], [[Ukraine]], killing at least 15 people and injuring seven others. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdre7g2je63o (BBC News)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Nigeria]] reports that [[Nigerian Army|its forces]] have killed a senior [[Boko Haram]] commander known as Abu Khalid, describing him as the group's deputy leader in the [[Sambisa Forest]], and ten other fighters during a raid in [[Borno State]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerian-army-says-it-killed-boko-haram-commander-10-fighters-2026-02-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**A [[Sudan Airways]] passenger flight lands at [[Khartoum International Airport]], [[Sudan]]'s main international airport, for the first time since the war began in 2023, resuming limited operations after renovations and [[2025 East Sudan drone attacks|earlier drone attacks]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/561583.aspx (AFP via ''Al-Ahram'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[68th Annual Grammy Awards]]
**At the 2026 [[Grammy Awards]], [[Kendrick Lamar]] wins five awards and surpasses [[Jay-Z]] as the [[Grammy Award milestones#Most Grammys won by a rapper|most awarded hip-hop artist]] in Grammy history, while [[Bad Bunny]]'s ''[[Debí Tirar Más Fotos]]'' becomes the first [[Spanish language|Spanish-language]] album to win [[Grammy Award for Album of the Year|Album of the Year]]. [https://apnews.com/article/2026-grammy-awards-4d631de5d968b51276a8f06b76580e20 (AP)]  [https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-news/kendrick-lamar-most-grammys-rapper-breaks-jay-z-record-1236491049/ (''The Hollywood Reporter'')]
**"[[Golden (Huntrix song)|Golden]]" from the film ''[[KPop Demon Hunters]]'' becomes the first [[K-pop]] song to win a Grammy after winning [[Grammy Award for Best Song Written for Visual Media|Best Song Written for Visual Media]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/south-korea-celebrates-pops-golden-historic-grammy-win-129775454 (AP via ABC News)]
**[[Steven Spielberg]] becomes the 22nd competitive [[EGOT]] awardee after winning a Grammy for [[Grammy Award for Best Music Film|Best Music Film]] for producing ''[[Music by John Williams]]''. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/americas/steven-spielberg-joins-elite-egot-club-with-first-grammy-win/3817624 (AA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Storm Kristin]]
**[[Portugal]] launches a [[Euro|€]]1 billion ([[United States dollar|US$]]1.2 billion) loan program to rebuild uninsured storm-damaged factories and a €500 million ($593 million) [[Line of credit|facility]] for short-term [[Market liquidity|liquidity]], while [[XXV Constitutional Government of Portugal|the government]] extends the [[State of emergency|state of calamity]] in about 60 [[Municipalities of Portugal|municipalities]] amid forecasts of further heavy rain and flooding. [https://www.reuters.com/world/portugal-launches-3-billion-package-help-rebuild-after-storm-kristin-2026-02-01/ (Reuters)]
*Nine people are killed and 21 others are injured, including seven critically, after a bus rolls off a road and crashes in [[Antalya province]], [[Turkey]]. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-passenger-bus-crash-antalya-f0bb05d33e8bc38f9ad85f1bfc520876 (AP)]
*Four people are killed and 28 others are injured after a bus carrying wedding guests collides with a truck and overturns in [[Lodhran District]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1970409/4-dead-28-injured-as-bus-carrying-wedding-party-overturns-in-punjabs-lodhran (''Dawn'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Costa Rican general election]]
**[[Costa Ricans]] vote to elect the [[President of Costa Rica|president]] and all 57 members of the [[Legislative Assembly of Costa Rica|Legislative Assembly]]. From a field of 20 candidates, [[Laura Fernández Delgado|Laura Fernández]] of the [[Sovereign People's Party (Costa Rica)|Sovereign People's Party]] (PPSO) wins the presidency with 48% of the vote. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdre7me407yo (BBC News)]
*[[Epstein Files]], [[Relationship of Peter Mandelson and Jeffrey Epstein]]
**[[Peter Mandelson]] resigns from [[Labour Party (UK)]] after the [[United States Department of Justice]] releases files showing that convicted child sex offender [[Jeffrey Epstein]] made £55,000 ($75,000) in payments to Lord Mandelson in three separate transactions in 2003 and 2004. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn8jm2vpve1o (BBC)]
*Tens of thousands of people gather in [[Prague]], [[Czech Republic]], in support of [[President of the Czech Republic|President]] [[Petr Pavel]] in his dispute with [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Czech Republic)|foreign minister]] [[Petr Macinka]] and his party [[Motorists for Themselves]]. [https://apnews.com/article/czech-president-petr-pavel-spat-foreign-minister-28ffbe24ceb5f5f9e9d6087aa9381d3c (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 Australian Open]]
**In [[tennis]], [[Tennis in Spain|Spanish]] player [[Carlos Alcaraz]] defeats [[Sport in Serbia|Serbian]] player [[Novak Djokovic]] in the [[2022 Australian Open – Men's singles|men's singles]] final 2–6, 6–2, 6–3, 7–5, to win his first [[Australian Open]] title, becoming the youngest man to complete the [[List of Grand Slam men's singles champions|career]] [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] in [[Singles (tennis)|singles]]. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/sports/othersports/2026/2/1/tennis-alcaraz-beats-djokovic-to-win-maiden-australian-open-title-1959 (AFP via ABS-CBN)] [https://www.espn.com/tennis/story/_/id/47795603/carlos-alcaraz-beats-novak-djokovic-australian-open-final (ESPN)]
*[[2026 European Men's Handball Championship]]
** In [[handball]], [[Denmark]] defeats [[Germany]] 34–27 and becomes [[2026 European Men's Handball Championship|European Champions]] in addition to being the reigning [[2025 World Men's Handball Championship|World]] and [[Handball at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|Olympic Champions]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/handball-germany-lose-to-denmark-in-euro-final/a-75754340 (DW)]
